stem.text: A student carried out tests for biological molecules on the **same** sample of milk.
The tests and their results were as follows.

items: Heating to $80\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ with Benedict’s solution gave a red colour.
Boiling with acid, followed by neutralisation, then heating to $80\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ with Benedict’s solution also gave a red colour.
Adding Biuret solution gave a purple colour.
Adding iodine solution gave a yellow colour.

stem.text: Which biological molecules **must** be present in the milk?
